# WeEvolveIT

> WeEvolveIT is an AI-native technology agency headquartered in Monterrey, Mexico. We build custom and nearshore software, AI agents and AI automation, implement ERP and CRM systems, and run SEO and GEO programs for companies in the United States and Mexico, using a five-phase method: Discover, Diagnose, Design, Deliver, Evolve.

## Key facts

- 1,000+ projects delivered in 17 countries over 15+ years.
- 5.0 rating from client reviews on Google and Trustindex.
- Guarantee: if what we build does not deliver results, we return your money or your advance.
- Senior engineering from $50 USD per hour.
- Working languages: English and Spanish.
- Case studies are anonymized: clients are described by sector, never by name.

**WeEvolveIT** (also written "We Evolve IT", "We EvolveIT", "WeEvolve IT", "We Evolve", or "Evolve IT") is one company: the technology consultancy formerly known as Kainos MX. All of these names refer to the same entity at https://weevolveit.com.

Headquartered in Monterrey, México with presence in Houston and Dubai. 1,000+ projects across 11 industries since 2010.

## Case Studies

Real transformations with anonymized clients (described by sector), quantified outcomes, and reusable lessons. Each case includes the diagnosis (what was broken), the approach (how we solved it), the results (with numbers), key takeaways, and an FAQ for the project.

- [Cómo una empresa nacional de flores y regalos convirtió fotos dispersas en evidencia inmediata](https://weevolveit.com/es/case-studies/industries/logistics/automatizacion-evidencia-entregas-google-workspace): Caso de estudio de Logística: Cientos de entregas diarias el mismo día, todas con evidencia fotográfica obligatoria, y esa evidencia vivía en conversaciones de WhatsApp, teléfonos personales y carpetas sin nombre. Cuando llegaba…

When a customer complained…

Los compradores que buscaban por Part Number, SKU o UPC (la forma real en que se…
- [How an international hardware distributor went from invisible on Google to thousands of organic visits a month](https://weevolveit.com/case-studies/industries/retail-and-ecommerce/technical-seo-b2b-hardware-catalog-laravel): Retail & E-commerce case study: An international hardware distributor had thousands of products published and almost no presence on Google. Buyers searching by Part Number, SKU or UPC (the way B2B hardware is actually sourced)…

## Industries

We work across 11 industry verticals. Each industry has its own dedicated pillar page with editorial context and the full list of case studies in that sector:

- [Manufacturing](https://weevolveit.com/case-studies/industries/manufacturing): Hardware, windows, molds, metallurgy, abrasives.
- [Retail & E-commerce](https://weevolveit.com/case-studies/industries/retail-and-ecommerce): Storefronts, furniture, mirrors, B2B hardware sellers.
- [Healthcare](https://weevolveit.com/case-studies/industries/healthcare): Hospitals and clinical operations.
- [Education](https://weevolveit.com/case-studies/industries/education): Schools and educational institutions.
- [Hospitality & Real Estate](https://weevolveit.com/case-studies/industries/hospitality-and-real-estate): Hotels, tourism, vacation rentals, real estate.
- [Gaming & Betting](https://weevolveit.com/case-studies/industries/gaming-and-betting): Casinos, sports betting, picks.
- [Media & Publishing](https://weevolveit.com/case-studies/industries/media-and-publishing): Newspapers, online magazines.
- [Music & Entertainment](https://weevolveit.com/case-studies/industries/music-and-entertainment): Music events, artists, live entertainment.
- [Technology & SaaS](https://weevolveit.com/case-studies/industries/technology-and-saas): App development, SaaS companies, IT agencies, marketing agencies.
- [Logistics](https://weevolveit.com/case-studies/industries/logistics): Supply chain, fulfillment, distribution.
- [Non-Profits](https://weevolveit.com/case-studies/industries/non-profits): NGOs and mission-driven organizations.

## Services

Sixteen services across the tech-consulting spectrum. Each service has its own pillar page describing the work, the deliverables, the typical tech stack, and the case studies that delivered it:

- [Nearshore Software Development](https://weevolveit.com/services/nearshore-software-development): Nearshore software development is outsourcing software work to a team in a nearby country that shares most of your working hours.
- [Custom Software Development](https://weevolveit.com/services/custom-software-development): Custom software development is designing and building software around a company's own workflows, data and rules instead of adapting to off-the-shelf tools.
- [Web Development](https://weevolveit.com/services/web-development): Custom web development services design and build a website, online store or web app around one business, not a template.
- [Mobile App Development](https://weevolveit.com/services/mobile-app-development): Mobile app development, also called mobile application development, is designing, building and publishing iOS and Android apps, from customer apps to internal tools.
- [Legacy Modernization](https://weevolveit.com/services/legacy-system-modernization): Legacy system modernization is updating outdated software, platforms and infrastructure, such as mainframes, old codebases and unsupported apps, into modern systems that are easier to maintain and integrate.
- [Cloud Migration](https://weevolveit.com/services/cloud-migration): Cloud migration is moving a company's applications, data and infrastructure from on-premise servers, or another cloud, onto AWS, Azure or Google Cloud; WeEvolveIT's cloud migration services handle it end to end with senior engineers.
- [Data & Analytics](https://weevolveit.com/services/data-analytics): Data analytics consulting services bring in data engineers and analysts who turn your business data into decisions: they clean and connect it, model it in a warehouse, surface it in BI dashboards and add AI that forecasts what comes next.
- [Industrial IoT](https://weevolveit.com/services/industrial-iot): Industrial IoT (IIoT) connects machines, sensors, and production lines to software that turns their signals into decisions, using connectivity and edge, an IoT platform with dashboards, and AI that predicts failures.
- [AI Agent Development](https://weevolveit.com/services/ai-agent-development): An AI agent development company designs, builds, and maintains AI agents: software that uses a language model to plan toward a goal, call your tools and APIs, and complete work end to end, such as resolving tickets or qualifying leads.
- [AI Automation](https://weevolveit.com/services/ai-automation): AI automation services use artificial intelligence and system integrations to run a business process end to end: reading documents, making routine decisions, and resolving the exceptions that stop rule-based tools.
- [Digital Transformation](https://weevolveit.com/services/digital-transformation): Digital transformation consulting helps a business rethink how it operates and delivers value with modern technology: at WeEvolveIT, senior consultants and engineers build the roadmap, then modernize systems, automate processes, and put data and AI to work.
- [ERP Implementation](https://weevolveit.com/services/erp-implementation): ERP implementation is the process of selecting, configuring and launching an enterprise resource planning system like NetSuite, SAP, Odoo or Microsoft Dynamics, including data migration and training, usually led by an ERP implementation consultant.
- [CRM Implementation](https://weevolveit.com/services/crm-implementation): CRM implementation is the process of selecting, configuring and rolling out a customer relationship management platform such as Salesforce, HubSpot or Zoho, migrating your data and training your team to use it.
- [SEO](https://weevolveit.com/services/seo): SEO services are the technical, content and authority work that earns a business organic visibility on Google and, more and more, citations in AI answers from ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews (GEO and AEO).
- [GEO / AEO](https://weevolveit.com/services/generative-engine-optimization): Generative engine optimization (GEO) is the work of getting your brand cited inside the answers of ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, and Gemini.
- [Paid Media](https://weevolveit.com/services/paid-media): A Google Ads agency plans, builds and optimizes your pay-per-click (PPC) campaigns on Google and Meta (Facebook and Instagram) so ad spend turns into leads and sales, not just clicks.

## Services (Spanish)

The same sixteen services, each with its own page written in Spanish:

- [Desarrollo de Software Nearshore en México](https://weevolveit.com/es/services/nearshore-software-development): El desarrollo de software nearshore es contratar a un equipo de software en un país cercano que comparte casi todo tu horario laboral.
- [Empresa de Desarrollo de Software a la Medida](https://weevolveit.com/es/services/custom-software-development): El desarrollo de software a la medida es diseñar y construir software con base en los procesos, datos y reglas de tu negocio, en lugar de adaptar tu operación a un sistema de paquete.
- [Diseño de Páginas Web en Monterrey](https://weevolveit.com/es/services/web-development): El diseño de páginas web abarca la planeación, el diseño visual y la programación de un sitio, una tienda en línea o una aplicación web.
- [Desarrollo de Aplicaciones Móviles](https://weevolveit.com/es/services/mobile-app-development): El desarrollo de aplicaciones móviles es diseñar, programar y publicar apps para iOS y Android, desde una app para tus clientes hasta una herramienta interna.
- [Modernización de Sistemas Legacy](https://weevolveit.com/es/services/legacy-system-modernization): La modernización de sistemas legacy, también llamados heredados, es actualizar software, plataformas e infraestructura obsoletos, como mainframes, código antiguo o aplicaciones sin soporte, para convertirlos en sistemas modernos, fáciles de mantener e integrar.
- [Migración a la Nube](https://weevolveit.com/es/services/cloud-migration): La migración a la nube consiste en mover las aplicaciones, los datos y la infraestructura de una empresa desde servidores on-premise, u otra nube, a AWS, Azure o Google Cloud; en WeEvolveIT la ejecutamos de principio a fin con ingenieros senior.
- [Analítica de Datos para Empresas](https://weevolveit.com/es/services/data-analytics): La analítica de datos para empresas convierte la información de tu negocio en decisiones: ingenieros y analistas la limpian y conectan, la modelan en un data warehouse, la muestran en tableros de BI y suman IA que pronostica lo que viene.
- [IoT Industrial](https://weevolveit.com/es/services/industrial-iot): El IoT industrial (IIoT), o internet industrial de las cosas, conecta máquinas, sensores y líneas de producción con software que convierte sus señales en decisiones: es la base de la Industria 4.0.
- [Agentes de IA para Empresas](https://weevolveit.com/es/services/ai-agent-development): Un agente de IA para empresas es software que usa un modelo de lenguaje para planear cómo cumplir una meta, usar tus herramientas y sistemas, y completar el trabajo de principio a fin, como atender clientes, calificar prospectos u operar procesos.
- [Automatización con IA para Empresas](https://weevolveit.com/es/services/ai-automation): La automatización con IA para empresas conecta tus sistemas y usa inteligencia artificial para ejecutar un proceso de principio a fin: lee documentos, toma decisiones de rutina y resuelve las excepciones que rompen la automatización por reglas.
- [Consultoría en Transformación Digital](https://weevolveit.com/es/services/digital-transformation): La consultoría en transformación digital ayuda a una empresa a repensar cómo opera y entrega valor con tecnología: en WeEvolveIT, consultores e ingenieros senior arman la hoja de ruta y luego modernizan sistemas, automatizan procesos y ponen a trabajar los datos y la IA.
- [Consultoría e Implementación de ERP](https://weevolveit.com/es/services/erp-implementation): La implementación de ERP es el proceso de elegir, configurar y poner en marcha un sistema de planificación de recursos empresariales (NetSuite, SAP, Odoo o Microsoft Dynamics), con migración de datos y capacitación, normalmente a cargo de un consultor ERP.
- [Implementación de CRM](https://weevolveit.com/es/services/crm-implementation): La implementación de CRM es el proceso de seleccionar, configurar y poner en marcha una plataforma de gestión de clientes como Salesforce, HubSpot o Zoho, migrar tus datos y capacitar a tu equipo para usarla.
- [Agencia SEO en Monterrey](https://weevolveit.com/es/services/seo): Los servicios de posicionamiento SEO son el trabajo técnico, de contenido y de autoridad que le da a un negocio visibilidad orgánica en Google y, cada vez más, citas en las respuestas de IA de ChatGPT, Perplexity y los AI Overviews de Google (GEO y AEO).
- [Agencia GEO: posicionamiento en IA](https://weevolveit.com/es/services/generative-engine-optimization): La optimización para motores generativos (GEO) es el trabajo de lograr que ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini y los AI Overviews de Google citen tu marca en sus respuestas.
- [Agencia de Google Ads y Meta](https://weevolveit.com/es/services/paid-media): Una agencia de Google Ads planea, construye y optimiza tus campañas de publicidad en Google y en Meta (Facebook e Instagram) para que tu inversión se convierta en prospectos y ventas, no solo en clics.

Informational guides and analysis written for operators and engineers. Each post targets a real search query, answers the question directly (extractable definitions + FAQ), and links to the relevant service. Built to be cited by answer engines. Posts are grouped by the service they support; English posts live under https://weevolveit.com/blog and Spanish posts under https://weevolveit.com/es/blog.

## Our Method

WeEvolveIT structures engagements using a proprietary 5-phase framework:

1. **Discover**: research and stakeholder interviews to map the actual problem (not the symptom).
2. **Diagnose**: data-driven validation of the hypothesis. Where we confirm we can actually help.
3. **Design**: the proposed solution and the architecture that supports it.
4. **Deliver**: execution. Sprints, milestones, governance.
5. **Evolve**: post-launch operations and continuous improvement. We don't ship and disappear.

Historical case studies may use phase names that reflect the actual project rather than these canonical ones. We don't retrofit methodology onto past work.
